newsitem.title: USA: New York Stock Exchange 1996 net income $74.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: New York Stock Exchange 1996 net income $74.4 mln.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Friday its net income for 1996 was $74.4 million, up from $56.7 million in 1995.
It said revenues for 1966 were $561.5 million compared with $500.8 million in 1995.

Fourth-quarter 1996 revenues totaled $146.9 million, up from $136.1 million in the comparable quarter in 1995. Net income for the quarter was $13.0 million, compared with $13.5 million in the 1995 quarter, it said.
During 1996, 279 companies listed with the exchange, compared with 175 companies in 1975. In the fourth quarter, 105 companies joined, compared with 70 in the similar quarter in 1995, it said.
Average daily trading volume for all of 1996 was 412.0 million shares, worth $16 billion, compared with $346.1 million shares worth $12.2 billion in 1995.
For the latest quarter, average daily volume was $433.4 million worth $17.0 billion. That compares with 370.3 million shares valued at $13.8 billion in the year-ago period, it said.
